description: This file defines the JobQueue class and related classes for managing a thread-based job queue, including scheduling, removing, and executing jobs, with optional profiling features.

classes.name: JobQueue
classes.description: Implements a thread-based job queue allowing scheduling, execution, and management of jobs.

classes.name: JobToken
classes.description: Represents a handle for a scheduled job, with validity checks.

classes.name: JobOwner
classes.description: Manages ownership of jobs, allowing scheduling, removal, and thread association.

methods.name: Schedule
methods.description: Schedules a job for execution after an optional delay.

methods.name: ScheduleAndWait
methods.description: Schedules a job and waits for its completion.

methods.name: RemoveJobByToken
methods.description: Removes a scheduled job identified by its token.

methods.name: StopSoon
methods.description: Requests the job queue to stop processing jobs soon.

methods.name: RunUntilStopped
methods.description: Runs the job queue until explicitly stopped.

methods.name: RunUntilIdle
methods.description: Runs the job queue until all jobs are processed.

methods.name: BelongsToCurrentThread
methods.description: Checks if the current thread owns the job queue.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the current thread's job queue instance.
